goal: Enable native Guix builds on RISC-V architectures
Bypass upstream build and test failures on riscv64 hosts
agreement: Strong support with verified matching x86_64 Guix build hashes (fanquake, willcl-ark, Sjors)
Approved after explanation on why manifest test skipping was needed (maflcko)
Requested description updates and clarification on failing NSIS packages (fanquake)

Benefits builders on emerging architectures without affecting primary release workflows
